description:
'Ryu Ji-woo' pursues beautiful things and only likes beautiful things.

Late one night, in the negligence, he witnesses 'Kim Do-ryun', a classmate in the same class, being threatened because of his sexual orientation.  
Even though Ji-woo wanted to pretend not to know about Do-ryun, which only causes incidents, his eyes continued to be drawn to his beautiful figure that suited his taste.  
'Choi Hwan', who has secretly had a crush on Ji-woo, feels uneasy about Ji-woo and starts to approach him impatiently...

Do-ryun that attracts externally, and a ring that fits well internally. Ji-woo conflicts between the two.  
How will this evil relationship between the three people end?

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/bluuuue), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/deep_blue), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000066749), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/1515037297), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=12027038), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=241257)
